title: Nested case-control with risk-set sampling (conditional logistic)
summary: The cohort hazard ratio from controls sampled from each case's risk set, by conditional logistic regression on the matched sets.

sizing._why: A matched or nested case-control has no form in the sizing catalog and must not borrow one.

pinned_defaults: Both: conditional logistic regression on the matched set with the covariate; R clogit(method = 'exact'); Python ConditionalLogit(method = 'newton').
Design: controls drawn from those still at risk at each case's event time (incidence density sampling); a person can be a control several times and later a case.
_no_rare_disease: With risk-set sampling the conditional OR estimates the hazard ratio however common the outcome. The fixture's outcome is common (about 40%) on purpose: controls drawn from everyone event-free at the end (cumulative sampling) give a mean log OR of 0.94 against a log HR of 0.69.
